craftItems.title: Travel Weather Planner
craftItems.subtitle: Independent Project
craftItems.summary: A data pipeline and dashboard that scores the best months to visit 16 destinations using 5 years of daily weather data.
bullets: Collected 5 years of daily weather data (29,216 records) for 16 destinations via API using Python and pandas.
Cleaned and structured the raw records into a consistent schema, handling missing values and normalizing units across all 16 destinations.
Built a PostgreSQL database with views, CTEs and window functions to score and rank the best months to travel.
Presented the ranked results in an interactive Tableau dashboard comparing famous vs. hidden-gem destinations by month.

craftItems.title: Delhi AQI Forecaster
craftItems.subtitle: Independent Project
craftItems.summary: A machine learning pipeline that forecasts Delhi's next-day PM2.5 by merging weather, air-quality, and NASA satellite fire data.
bullets: Merged weather, air-quality and NASA satellite fire data (881 days) to forecast Delhi's next-day PM2.5.
Engineered lag and rolling-window features from the merged time series to capture pollution build-up and weather effects.
Compared Linear Regression and Random Forest against a persistence baseline, evaluating performance with time-based validation.
Validated the models across two distinct test periods to confirm the forecast held up beyond a single season.

craftItems.title: Hotel Booking Data Analysis
craftItems.subtitle: Independent Project
craftItems.summary: Exploratory analysis of a hotel reservations dataset — cleaning, outlier detection, and distribution analysis.
bullets: Performed exploratory data analysis on hotel reservations, applying data cleaning and distribution analysis with pandas.
Investigated arrival patterns through time-series aggregation, uncovering seasonal peaks and weekday/weekend booking trends.
Applied quantile-based outlier detection and computed distribution statistics (mean, median, standard deviation, KDE) to understand booking lead times.
Visualized findings through histograms and KDE plots to surface actionable patterns in cancellations and lead-time behavior.

craftItems.title: UPI Transaction Analysis Dashboard
craftItems.subtitle: Independent Project
craftItems.summary: An interactive Power BI dashboard for exploring UPI transaction patterns across banks and time.
bullets: Built an interactive multi-page Power BI dashboard analyzing UPI transactions across banks and time periods.
Designed dynamic slicers, column and line charts, and pivot tables for drill-down analysis of transaction patterns by bank and category.
Implemented bookmarks and action buttons for guided navigation, turning raw transaction records into actionable insights.
Applied data modeling and DAX-driven visualization best practices to transform the dataset into a clear, decision-ready report.

craftItems.title: YouTube Content-Based Recommender System
craftItems.subtitle: Independent Project
craftItems.summary: A content-based recommender built on 40,000+ YouTube videos using TF-IDF and cosine similarity.
bullets: Designed and implemented a content-based recommendation system on 40,000+ real-world YouTube videos, applying TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity to model content relationships.
Conducted exploratory data analysis to investigate engagement patterns — including views-likes correlation and category-level performance — informing feature selection for the recommendation model.
Independently designed the experiment end-to-end: data acquisition, cleaning, feature engineering, model implementation, and evaluation.
